title: carduncellus monspelliensium subsp. matritensis
intro: Carduncellus monspelliensium subsp. matritensis, commonly known as Spanish cardoon, is a plant species belonging to the genus Carduncellus in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The Spanish cardoon is a perennial plant known for its edible stems and leaves, which have been traditionally used in Mediterranean cuisine. The health benefits of Carduncellus monspelliensium subsp. matritensis include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
